items.example: Have you ever been to the Sahara Desert?

items.phrase: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
items.example: Have you ever slept in a tent? — No, I haven't.
No, I haven't, but I'd like to.
Have you seen the film yet? — No, not yet.
It was an amazing experience — I'd do it again.

items.phrase: be different from what I expected
items.translation: отличаться от того, что я ожидал
items.example: The city is very different from what I expected.
We get up at six and take two boats.
We've got two days in Cairo.
The train journey is long, but the views are amazing.
I climbed a volcano on holiday in Italy.
You did a bungee jump? — How was it?
It was terrifying, but I'd do it again.
